## Process and merge input dataset

```{r}
length(unique(raw_data_ls$summary$Paper_id))
```

```{r}
nrow(raw_data_ls$summary)
```

```{r}
nrow(raw_data_ls$extended)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- raw_data_ls$summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(raw_data_ls$extended %>%
                     dplyr::rename(Comparator_Ext = Comparator) %>%
                     dplyr::select(c("paper_id", "Comparator_Ext", "Population extract",
                                     "Diagnosis", "Setting", "Setting_Category",
                                     "Results", "No. intervention evaluated")) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(Paper_id = "paper_id"))

```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  dplyr::filter(Quality == "H")
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```
```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
    transform_to_filtered_patterns(col = `Evaluation methods`,
                                   allowable_patterns_chr = "CUA")
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CE_Results_Raw = `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`
  )
```

```{r}
test_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_numbered_items(

    source_col =
      `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`,

    item_nbr_col =
      "CE_Item_Nbr",

    item_seq_col =
      "CE_Item_Seq",

    item_text_col =
      "CE_Item_Text",

    pre_item_text_col =
      "CE_Pre_Item_Text",

    post_item_text_col =
      "CE_Post_Item_Text",

    original_text_col =
      "CE_Raw"

  )
```


```{r}
ce_perspectives_ls <- list(

  Healthcare = c(

    "Healthcare perspective:",
    "Healthcare sector perspective:",
    "Healthcare sector:",
    "Health sector perspective:",
    "Health sector:",
    "Health-care perspective:",
    "Healthcare:"

  ),

  Payer = c(

    "Healthcare payer:",
    "Health-care payer:",
    "Australian Government (third-party payer of healthcare services)"

  ),

  Societal = c(

    "Partial societal perspective:",
    "Societal perspective:",
    "Partial societal:",
    "Societal:",
    "Sococietal:"

  )

)
```

```{r}
test_tb <- test_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_ce_perspective(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    variants_ls =
      ce_perspectives_ls,

    perspective_col =
      "Perspective",

    original_text_col =
      "CE_Item_Text_Original",

    matched_pattern_col =
      "Matched_Perspective"

  )
```


```{r}
test_tb <- test_tb %>%
  transform_to_extract_trailing_text(source_col = CE_Item_Text,
                                     trailing_text_col = "CE_Trailing_Text",
                                     section_patterns_chr = c("Incremental NMB:",
                                                              "ICER - "))
```


```{r}
test_tb <- test_tb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Has_Secondary_Block =
      !is.na(
        CE_Trailing_Text
      )
  )
```

```{r}
test_tb <- test_tb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Has_Secondary_Block =
      !is.na(
        CE_Trailing_Text
      )
  )
```


```{r}
test_tb <- test_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_unnumbered_perspectives(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    variants_ls =
      ce_perspectives_ls

  )
```


```{r}
statistic_patterns_ls <- list(

  ICER = c(
    "ICER =",
    "ICER:",
    "ICER - "
  ),

  INMB = c(
    "INMB"
  ),

  NMB = c(
    "Incremental NMB:",
    "NMB ="
  ),

  ROI = c(
    "ROI:"
  )

)

test_tb <- test_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_ce_statistics(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    statistic_patterns_ls =
      statistic_patterns_ls,

    statistic_col =
      "Statistic_Type",

    statistic_text_col =
      "Statistic_Text",

    original_text_col =
      "Statistic_Source"

  )
```

```{r}
 test_tb %>%
dplyr::filter(
Paper_id %in% c(

)
) %>%
dplyr::select(
Paper_id,
CE_Item_Nbr,

CE_Trailing_Text
)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>% 
  transform_to_clean_text(source_col = `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`,
                          original_value_col ="Copy_1_Of_CE_Results",   
                          keep_after_patterns_chr = c(":", 
                                                      "ICER - $ per QALY gained  " # Bad idea???
                                                      ),
                          except_if_contains_patterns_chr = c("Healthcare perspective:" ),
                          remove_trailing_patterns_chr = NULL)
```

```{r}
variants_ls <- list(Healthcare = c("Healthcare sector", "Healthcare sector perspective", "Health sector perspective", "Healthcare perspective"),
                     Payer = c("Healthcare payer"), 
                     Societal = c("Partial societal perspective", "Societal perspective", "Societal", "Sococietal")) 
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  transform_to_extract_variant_segment(source_col = Perspective,
    text_col = `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`,
    original_text_col = "Copy_2_Of_CE_Results",
    multiple_matches_col = Multiple_Perspectives,
    variants_ls = variants_ls,
    delimiter_chr = ":",
    end_patterns_chr = c(" across all perspectives ",
                         " Both have 94"),
    remainder_col = "Extra_CE_Results_2",
    debug_lgl = T) %>% 
  transform_to_clean_text(source_col = `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`,
                          remove_trailing_patterns_chr = c(" (2)", " (3)"))
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  transform_to_split_cols(source_col = "Intervention description",
                          before_col = "Category",
                          after_col =  "Description") %>%
  transform_to_permissible_values(source_col = "Category",
                                  permissible_values_chr = c("Lifestyle therapy", "Multicomponent",
                                                             "Neuromodulation", "Parenting",
                                                             "Psychoeducation", "Psychotherapy", "Stepped care",
                                                              "Support service",  "Training"),
                                  original_value_col = "Old_Category",
                                  multiple_matches_col = "ErrorFlag",
                                  residual_value_col = "Subcategory") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Description = Description %>% stringr::str_remove_all("Lifestyle therapy \\(nutrition & physical activity\\) ") %>% stringr::str_to_sentence())
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
    transform_to_permissible_values(source_col = "Subcategory",
                                  permissible_values_chr = c("Brief", "Carer", 
                                                             "Combined individual-group", "Health care professional", 
                                                             "Nutrition & physical activity", 
                                                             "Online"),
                                  original_value_col = "Old_Subcategory",
                                  multiple_matches_col = "ErrorFlag2",
                                  unmatched_action_chr = "set_na")
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  transform_to_filtered_patterns(col = Category,
                                 banned_patterns_chr = "Neuromodulation")
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
```
